name: Nicola Carlisle
source:
[i]"Hey, never mind worrying about them being in the way; it's way more important that I dress true to my personal style!"[/i]

[b]Occupation:[/b] Vampire hunter
[b]Interest:[/b] History
[b]Weapon:[/b] Antique Rifle

A vampire hunter with a particularly adorable appearance.

Do not let her charming appearance and demeanor fool you; she is not only a hunter, but also a sharp-minded history researcher.

She is fond of antiques, and has no time for liars.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=nicola]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
